info.description:
# SnackCheck — honor kitchen ledger
Employees one-tap log snacks and drinks against their Nextcloud account. Managers run catalog, Kitchen pulse, top-up hints, period close, and cent-reconciled payroll CSV/XLSX for HR deduction outside the app.
**Free AGPL web app.** Kitchen Tablet companion is licensed separately (`SNK2` device licences). Web is never gated by the device licence.
## Clear limits
- Not a POS / TSE / gastro Kassensystem - Not DATEV Lohn live posting - Not InventoryCheck — optional on-hand/par scalars only; never stock movements; logs never auto-decrement stock
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 32–34 · PHP 8.2–8.5 · MySQL or PostgreSQL

# SnackCheck — Honor-System für die Büroküche
Mitarbeitende tippen Snacks und Getränke auf ihr Nextcloud-Konto. Verwaltung: Katalog, Kitchen Pulse, Nachfüllhinweise, Periodenabschluss und centgenaue Lohn-CSV/XLSX.
**Kostenlose AGPL-Web-App.** Das Küchen-Tablet wird separat lizenziert (`SNK2`).
## Voraussetzungen
- Nextcloud 32–34 · PHP 8.2–8.5 · MySQL oder PostgreSQL
